notes:
## New features
- Barrier heights where you need them. Set the height of a whole barrier, or pick nodes or segments on the plan (or in the tables) and give them their own heights. With "Slope top between nodes" on (the default) the top runs in a straight line from node to node; turn it off for level panels that step at each node. The calculation, the 3D view and the editor all use the same top.
- Standard barriers by default. New barriers use the ISO 9613-2 default construction. Tick "Custom construction" to choose a material, surface density and reflection settings; untick it to return to standard.
- Berm height along its length. Each berm node has its own crest height, with the crest sloping in a straight line between nodes. This is used by the terrain, the calculation and the 3D view.
- Berm 3D look. Show a berm as an earth berm, or as part of the terrain so the ground and basemap drape over it.
- Two basemap layers. The Editor's basemap bar now has an A/B layer switch, a style button and the basemap list. Layer B is drawn over layer A. Each layer has its own opacity, contrast, colour or black-and-white, and blend mode, saved with the project.
- Minor isoline opacity. Minor isolines have their own opacity, and now default to 25% of the outline width.

## Changes
- Buttons no longer have outlines, and hover highlights fade in and out.
- Tooltips are a compact dark label so they can't be mistaken for buttons.
- The Project panel has been reorganised: New and Open sit beside the project title with Save, the short fields come first, and the description grows with its text.
- Contour colour presentation has Bands/Gradient, the palette and its actions on one row, with the colour bar below.
- The Inputs tab shows plain object types and each object's area or length.
- The repository has been reorganised: reference material is under reference/, dated notes under docs/archive/, and generated output is kept outside the repository.

## Bug fixes
- Contour bands no longer show stepped edges, missing outlines or missing labels next to buildings that share a wall. Adjoining buildings drawn a hair apart left a hidden gap that merged two bands; such buildings are now joined, and any area that still needs splitting follows the smooth contour line.
- SmartSmooth simplification and Bézier smoothing now reach every isoline, not only the inner rings.
- A fill or outline opacity of 0% is kept at 0% instead of reverting to 100%.
- A project whose saved calculation period no longer existed showed one period in the top bar while calculating another. It now uses the period shown.
- The 3D view now updates when a barrier's heights change.
